disease_resistance.summary: Sclerotinia: reported tolerant per the GDM-5 abstract (JOR article 126930). Full disease reaction table was not retrieved. Reaction of GDM-5 against major diseases in Zone II is listed as a ResearchGate profile title, but values were not retrieved. The powdery mildew row in the DRMR report was not attributed to GDM-5 because it is ambiguous whether it refers to GDM-4 or GDM-5, so no powdery mildew resistance is claimed.

pest_resistance.summary: Mustard aphid: reported tolerant to natural infestation per the GDM-5 abstract (JOR article 126930). The aphid infestation index table is listed as a ResearchGate profile title, but values were not retrieved. The aphid tolerance row in the DRMR report was not attributed to GDM-5 because of the GDM-4/GDM-5 ambiguity.

agronomic_details.yield: Weighted mean seed yield of 2213 kg/ha across IVT and AVT rainfed trials at five locations (rabi 2011-12 to 2013-14). This exceeded the national check Kranti (1758 kg/ha) and the zonal checks Geeta, RB-50 and RGN-48. Average oil yield was 897 kg/ha, about 24.6% above Kranti and 81.2% above Geeta. The yield range of 2081-2360 kg/ha in the DRMR comparison table and the maturity range of 134-155 days in the DRMR report are not explicitly attributed to GDM-5 in the digest and were therefore not used.
agronomic_details.stability: Not found in searched sources beyond the weighted mean across five locations and multiple seasons (rabi 2011-12 to 2013-14). No formal stability analysis was reported.
agronomic_details.adaptation: Rainfed, timely-sown conditions in Zone II. Recommended for rainfed ecosystems in the states listed under variety_profile.
agronomic_details.maturity_days: Not found in searched sources (GDM-5-specific days-to-maturity data appear only as a ResearchGate table title, not retrieved).
agronomic_details.plant_characteristics: Medium-tall growth habit. Tolerant to lodging and shattering. Seed oil content 40.50%. Other morphological characteristics: Not found in searched sources.
agronomic_details.field_trials: IVT and AVT rainfed trials at five locations, rabi 2011-12 to 2013-14: weighted mean seed yield 2213 kg/ha, higher than Kranti (1758 kg/ha) and zonal checks Geeta, RB-50 and RGN-48. Seed oil content 40.50%, average oil yield 897 kg/ha (about 24.6% above Kranti and 81.2% above Geeta). Trials under the AICRP varietal programme in 2020-21 and 2017-18 on spacing and nutrients did not name GDM-5 and were excluded. No separate AICRP trial report with GDM-5 data was retrieved.

search_metadata.evidence_digest:
STRESS TOLERANCE
Tolerant to lodging and shattering, with a medium-tall growth habit; evaluated as a rainfed variety for Zone II -- https://epubs.icar.org.in/index.php/JOR/article/view/126930
Reported tolerant to biotic stresses including mustard aphid (under natural conditions) and Sclerotinia; the abstract snippet is cut off before the full list, so drought, heat, salinity, flood and submergence tolerance were not confirmed -- https://epubs.icar.org.in/index.php/JOR/article/view/126930
Described as suited to timely-sown rainfed conditions -- https://www.drmr.res.in/aicrp2021/DRMR-PC-Report-2021.pdf

DISEASE AND PEST
Tolerant to mustard aphid (natural infestation) and Sclerotinia, per the GDM-5 abstract; full disease reaction table not retrieved -- https://epubs.icar.org.in/index.php/JOR/article/view/126930
Reaction of GDM-5 against major diseases in Zone II and an aphid infestation index table are listed as titles on a ResearchGate profile, but the values were not retrieved -- https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Aanandi-Jat
Note: the DRMR report row mentioning powdery mildew and aphid tolerance sits in a table where it is ambiguous whether it refers to GDM-4 or GDM-5, so it was not attributed to GDM-5 -- https://www.drmr.res.in/aicrp2021/DRMR-PC-Report-2021.pdf

AGRONOMY AND TRIALS
Weighted mean seed yield 2213 kg/ha across IVT and AVT rainfed trials at five locations (rabi 2011-12 to 2013-14), higher than national check Kranti (1758 kg/ha) and zonal checks Geeta, RB-50 and RGN-48 -- https://epubs.icar.org.in/index.php/JOR/article/view/126930
Seed oil content 40.50%, average oil yield 897 kg/ha, about 24.6% above Kranti and 81.2% above Geeta -- https://epubs.icar.org.in/index.php/JOR/article/view/126930
Yield range 2081-2360 kg/ha and oil content 38.0-41.4% in an AICRP-style comparison table -- https://www.drmr.res.in/aicrp2021/DRMR-PC-Report-2021.pdf ; https://tractorkarvan.com/blog/cultivation-of-mustard-in-india
Maturity 134-155 days in the DRMR report; days-to-maturity data for GDM-5 appear only as a table title on ResearchGate, not retrieved -- https://www.drmr.res.in/aicrp2021/DRMR-PC-Report-2021.pdf
Field trial of GDM-5 under the AICRP varietal programme, 2020-21 and 2017-18 studies were on other topics (spacing, nutrients) and did not name GDM-5 in the retrieved text, so they were excluded -- No evidence found for GDM-5-specific agronomy beyond the above

GENETICS AND QTL
Pedigree-method derivation from a cross between BIO 129-97 and NDR 9503 -- https://epubs.icar.org.in/index.php/JOR/article/view/126930
QTL or marker studies on GDM-5: No evidence found (search returned only a soybean pod-shattering marker paper by the same group, which concerns soybean and was discarded) -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/338096032_Validation_of_molecular_markers_for_pod_shattering_tolerance_in_soybean_Glycine_max_L_Merrill

BREEDER AND INSTITUTION
Developed at the Castor-Mustard Research Station, Sardarkrushinagar Dantiwada Agricultural University (SDAU), Sardarkrushinagar, Gujarat -- https://epubs.icar.org.in/index.php/JOR/article/view/126930
Authors of the GDM-5 paper (the paper does not separately label a lead breeder): K P Prajapati, P J Patel, J R Patel, B K Patel, S K Shah, A L Jat, G P Gangwar, A G Desai, all at Castor-Mustard Research Station, SDAU -- https://epubs.icar.org.in/index.php/JOR/article/view/126930
Released under the name Gujarat Dantiwada Mustard 5 in the DRMR report, with SKM 518 as the trial code -- https://www.drmr.res.in/aicrp2021/DRMR-PC-Report-2021.pdf
Institute background on rapeseed-mustard research at SDAU Oilseeds Research Centre -- https://www.sdau.edu.in/Research/68

CONTACT DETAILS
Institute-level address only (from the GDM-5 paper affiliation): Castor-Mustard Research Station, Sardarkrushinagar Dantiwada Agricultural University, Sardarkrushinagar-385 506, Gujarat -- https://epubs.icar.org.in/index.php/JOR/article/view/126930
Institute website: www.sdau.edu.in (research page: https://www.sdau.edu.in/Research/68)
Breeder email, phone and station phone: No evidence found in the retrieved pages.

PUBLICATIONS
Prajapati, K. P., Patel, P. J., Patel, J. R., Patel, B. K., Shah, S. K., Jat, A. L., Gangwar, G. P., & Desai, A. G. (2019). GDM-5: Region specific high yielding and high oil content variety of Indian mustard (Brassica juncea L. Czern and Coss.) suitable for rainfed ecosystem. Journal of Oilseeds Research, 36(2), 73-78 -- https://epubs.icar.org.in/index.php/JOR/article/view/126930
(Year and volume/pages taken from the ResearchGate reproduction of the same article, which gives J. Oilseeds Res. 36(2): 73-78, June 2019 -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/338096032_Validation_of_molecular_markers_for_pod_shattering_tolerance_in_soybean_Glycine_max_L_Merrill)
Excluded as not naming GDM-5: GDM-4 paper (ISOR vol. 34-4, https://isor.in/wp-content/uploads/2022/10/vol-34-4.pdf); GM 6 (Banas Sona) paper (https://epubs.icar.org.in/index.php/JOR/article/view/137209); soybean marker paper (see GENETICS).
KrishiKosh thesis on mustard plot-size uniformity trials (2015): does not name GDM-5 in the retrieved text, so excluded -- https://krishikosh.egranth.ac.in/server/api/core/bitstreams/c77998d0-ba15-42c4-a9bf-ed82ebb38fe8/content
AICRP/ICAR reports: DRMR Project Coordinator's Report 2020-21 lists the variety in its release table (https://www.drmr.res.in/aicrp2021/DRMR-PC-Report-2021.pdf); no separate trial report with GDM-5 data was retrieved.

SEED AVAILABILITY
No evidence found. The seed-availability search returned only unrelated seed sellers (GDM Seeds Inc, spice and garden seed shops, NCDEX mustard futures, mandi price listings) and no NSC, State Seed Corporation, KVK, SAU seed-sales or dealer listing for GDM-5 -- https://www.ncdex.com/products/RMSEED

RECOMMENDED STATES
Punjab, Haryana, Jammu, Northern Rajasthan and Delhi, identified for rainfed conditions in the DRMR report -- https://www.drmr.res.in/aicrp2021/DRMR-PC-Report-2021.pdf
Notified state list (2008-2019) includes GDM-5 under Delhi, Haryana and Punjab; Jammu and Rajasthan are not shown there -- https://oilseeds.dac.gov.in/Rapeseed.aspx
Commercial listing gives Punjab, Haryana, Rajasthan and Delhi -- https://tractorkarvan.com/blog/cultivation-of-mustard-in-india
Discrepancy: the input record says "Rajasthan"; sources say "Northern Rajasthan" (DRMR) or do not specify.

NAME NOTE
variety_name "Gujarat Dantiwada Mustard-5 (GDM 5) (SKM 518)" and seednet_variety_name are the same string here. Evidence refers to GDM-5 / Gujarat Dantiwada Mustard 5 (and SKM 518 in the DRMR report). The Seednet portal itself was not reached, so no Seednet-specific record (crop name "INDIAN RAPESEED AND MUSTARD (YELLOW SARSON)") was verified; the DRMR table lists the crop as Indian mustard (Brassica juncea), which conflicts with the "yellow sarson" label and should be checked on seednet.gov.in.

search_metadata.evidence_digest:
EVIDENCE DIGEST: Jammu Mustard 135 (SEEDNET name: JAMMU MUSTARD 135 (JM 13-5); code JM 13-5; crop: mustard / Indian rapeseed and mustard, yellow sarson)

Search note: Four web_search queries were run. The first three covered variety/release, breeder/institute, and research. The fourth covered seed availability. A fifth query, to check the SKUAST release record and the Seednet notification, was blocked by the tool's usage limit. No page was found that names JAMMU MUSTARD 135, JM 13-5, or the SKUAST-J release, so every heading below reports the absence of evidence rather than an attribution.

STRESS TOLERANCE -- No evidence found. The searches returned nothing on drought, heat, salinity, flood, or submergence tolerance for this variety.

DISEASE AND PEST -- No evidence found. Nothing on Alternaria, white rust, downy mildew, aphid, or other resistance for this variety.

AGRONOMY AND TRIALS -- No evidence found. No maturity, yield, sowing-date, or multi-location trial data for this variety.

GENETICS AND QTL -- No evidence found. No parentage (the record says "Not specified") and no marker or QTL study for this variety.

BREEDER AND INSTITUTION -- No evidence found. No breeder name, developing scientist, or station was identified for this variety. The institution in the record is Sher-e-Kashmir University of Agricultural Sciences & Technology of Jammu. Its name was not confirmed by any search result.

CONTACT DETAILS -- No evidence found. No breeder, institute email, phone, postal address, or contact page for SKUAST-Jammu was returned.

PUBLICATIONS -- No evidence found. The closest results were a general mustard cultivar paper (Springer, "Development and characterization of new high yielding mustard cultivar suitable for crop rotation due to earliness", https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s10722-025-02480-2) and an academia.edu mustard research document from CSAUAT Kanpur. Neither page names Jammu Mustard 135 or JM 13-5 in the retrieved text, so neither is attributed to this variety.

SEED AVAILABILITY -- No evidence found. The searches returned only retail listings for generic mustard or peeli sarson seed (for example, a TradeIndia Jammu mustard seed listing and an Amazon product page). These are different products and were discarded.

RECOMMENDED STATES -- No evidence found. The record states "UT of Jammu & Kashmir", but no search result confirmed this recommendation.

Suggested next steps: check the Seednet portal entry directly for JAMMU MUSTARD 135 (JM 13-5), the ICAR CSC/AICRP-Rapeseed-Mustard annual reports, and the SKUAST-Jammu website or its Mustard section for release notification and breeder details.
